observation: contextBundle deduplicated raw requested path strings before slash and ./ normalization, so several aliases for one real repository file could be admitted repeatedly, duplicating cognition input and consuming the bounded file/byte budget multiple times.
pre_fix_reproduction: Requesting ./src/a.js, src\a.js and src/a.js admitted three copies of the same file instead of one.
change: Normalize requested paths to a POSIX repository-relative form before deduplication, then run the existing credential, extension, ancestor, symlink, UTF-8 and byte-budget admission checks.
truth_boundary: This deduplicates lexical path aliases only. Hard-link identity aliases, globally optimal semantic context selection and files absent from bounded observation remain separate concerns.
